name: theme resilience and dark-mode contrast audit

auditFindings.issue: Theme script ordering drift after v54
auditFindings.detail: 22 HTML pages loaded ymir-theme.js after the first stylesheet, which could cause a light/dark flash before theme attributes are applied.
auditFindings.fix: Reordered all 182 HTML pages so ymir-theme.js loads before the first stylesheet and updated the manifest sync script to preserve that ordering.

auditFindings.issue: Dark mode did not harden Element Plus poppers/tables/form controls enough
auditFindings.detail: v54 covered main surfaces but dropdowns, tables, checkboxes, radios, switches, sliders, metrics, and result rows could still inherit light surfaces from Element Plus or older CSS.
auditFindings.fix: Added v55 dark contrast overrides for Element Plus poppers, tables, form controls, result rows, metrics, and reference cards.

auditFindings.issue: Theme toggle was single-node and partially English-only
auditFindings.detail: v54 updated only the first theme toggle and used English title/aria strings.
auditFindings.fix: Theme script now updates all toggles, localizes aria/title text, syncs color-scheme, injects theme-color metadata, and exposes setPreference().
